All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: The latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, so v2.3.1 will need investigation before any re-release.
